channel.title: Bhavin Mistry | Enterprise AI Insights
channel.description: Practical frameworks, architectures, and perspectives on Enterprise AI, AI Engineering, and Agentic Systems by Bhavin Mistry.

item.title: Enterprise AI Engineering: From Experimentation to Production
item.description: Why 88% of enterprise AI initiatives get stuck in pilot purgatory, and the engineering disciplines required to bridge the gap between proof-of-concept demos and P&L value realization.

item.title: Why Enterprise AI Agents Fail After the Demo
item.description: Deconstructing the failure modes of autonomous agents in enterprise environments: error compounding, state drift, permission blindness, and non-deterministic execution.

item.title: Enterprise RAG Architecture: A Production Blueprint
item.description: Moving beyond naive vector search: how hybrid sparse-dense retrieval, document-level ACLs, and cross-encoder reranking deliver reliable enterprise retrieval systems.

item.title: RAG vs Agentic RAG: Enterprise Architecture Decision Guide
item.description: A structured architectural framework to evaluate when deterministic one-shot RAG suffices versus when multi-hop agentic retrieval justifies its cost and latency overhead.

item.title: AI Code Review Agents in the Enterprise SDLC
item.description: How to deploy automated code review agents that enforce architectural conventions and security postures without drowning developers in noise.

item.title: Enterprise AI Governance Without Killing Innovation
item.description: A pragmatic governance framework for highly regulated environments (such as Australian Financial Services and APRA CPS 234) that balances compliance with rapid experimentation.
